_meta._comment: Phase 1 complete on real hardware 2026-07-28 (transport sanity — scan, connect, GATT, GAP/device-info reads, notification stream). Phase 2 complete 2026-07-29: commands.recording is VERIFIED via a 3/3 CameraSession round trip (see that block's provenance). ble_name re-confirmed by examples/scan_camera.py on v8.6 rather than inherited: the physical unit (BLE address CC:86:EC:72:E0:A6) is the same one upgraded from v7.9 on 2026-07-27, and the advertisement name identifies the hardware, not the firmware. Phase 3 in progress 2026-07-30: the passive settings sweep (step 9) populated `codecs`, most of `resolutions`, and the report-side coordinates of commands.codec_quality and commands.recording_format — all CANDIDATE, no write yet sent on this firmware. commands.video_format and a partial fps_modes (23.98/24/30) were then added as explicit CANDIDATE hypotheses to unblock step 10, which cannot build a probe packet without them — see docs/settings.md 18.6 and those blocks' own provenance. A follow-up dedicated fps sweep (2026-07-30) filled in 25/29.97/50/59.94 and reconfirmed 30 byte-identically across two independent sessions; 60fps is deliberately absent — see docs/settings.md 18.7 and fps_modes._fps_60_comment for the candidate-ceiling finding this produced. Still outstanding for Phase 3: every dimension_enum (step 10, active), HD's width/height, confirming whether 60fps is reachable at all here, and a confirming write for all three settings families (step 12). _meta.status stays UNVERIFIED because it describes the WHOLE profile; each command block carries its own provenance.status — recording's is already VERIFIED.

ble._comment: Confirmed 2026-07-28 by tools/query/ble_services_chars.py on real v8.6 hardware: INCOMING_CONTROL (b864e140-76a0-416a-bf30-5876504537d9) advertises property 'indicate'. All 3 expected services and all 10 expected characteristics in constants.py were found with 0 missing and 0 extra, so no characteristic_incoming override is needed on this firmware.

gap_meta_data._comment: Confirmed readable 2026-07-28 by tools/query/gap_meta_data.py on real v8.6 hardware: DEVICE_NAME read back 'A:AF3DC814' and APPEARANCE read back 0x8403 (33795), after which the session disconnected only on its own intentional teardown. NOTE — this is a behavioural CHANGE FROM v7.9, where reading GAP characteristics disconnected the camera and the field was therefore set false. Re-checked on this firmware per the workflow's firmware-upgrade rule; the v7.9 hazard did not reproduce.

device_info_meta_data._comment: Confirmed readable 2026-07-28 by tools/query/device_meta_data.py on real v8.6 hardware: MANUFACTURER read back 'Blackmagic Design' and MODEL read back 'Pocket Cinema Camera 6K G2' (both NUL-padded), with no disconnect. Also a change from the v7.9 profile, which records false.

provenance.method: passive sniffer (sniffer_recording.py) + guided discovery (discover_command.py, manual --category/--parameter seed) with per-candidate operator confirmation and wire echoes, then deterministic active send (send_record_command.py) and an echo-verified CameraSession round trip (examples/record_start_stop.py, 3/3 cycles)
capture_refs: examples/record_start_stop.py console log, 2026-07-29 14:04 run (not saved to tools/captures/ — this example doesn't call save_capture)
provenance.notes: Re-sniffed on v8.6, not inherited from the v7.9 profile (design principle 6) — and the reserved byte genuinely differs, which is why that matters. RESERVED BYTE INDIFFERENT: the 2026-07-29 sweep sent all four (value, reserved) combinations and the camera acted on every one, so 0x00 and 0x01 both work; v7.9 records 0x01, this profile records 0x00. 0x00 is canonical here because it is the only reserved value with a clean wire echo for BOTH outcomes (start 'FF 0A 00 00 0A 01 01 02 02 00 40 00 01 03', stop 'FF 0A 00 00 0A 01 01 02 00 00 40 00 01 03'), and because it matches the reserved byte the camera itself uses in every camera-originated report on this family. The reserved=0x01 start candidate was operator-confirmed only — its capture window caught the post-connect initial-payload burst instead of the response (the known first-candidate race in docs/command_discovery.md's safety model), so it has no echo of its own; reserved=0x01 stop did echo cleanly. Echo payload trailing bytes '00 40 00 01 03' are identical to v7.9's and remain not understood (hypothesis: SDI Cat 10 Param 1 transport-mode struct, docs/protocol.md). PROMOTED TO VERIFIED 2026-07-29 on Phase 2 steps 8.4 and 8.5: send_record_command.py produced clean echoes for both directions, then examples/record_start_stop.py ran the real CameraSession echo-verified round trip 3/3 start, 3/3 stop, 0/3 stopped early, clip durations 7s/5s/4s. Every TX in that run was byte-exact to this block ('FF 05 00 00 0A 01 01 00 02' / '... 00 00', 3 each), so the reserved=0x00 choice is confirmed through the production write path, not just the discovery tool. TIMECODE also read 00:00:00:00 at each start, matching docs/timecode.md's finding that the camera resets it on record start.

provenance.method: passive sniffer (sniffer_settings.py), one capture window per concrete codec/variant so each payload is unambiguously attributable
provenance.notes: REPORT SIDE ONLY so far. Camera-originated 0x0A/0x00 reports confirmed on v8.6: operation 0x02 (CAMERA_REPORT), data-type byte 0x01 (INT8), payload exactly 2 bytes [codec_id, variant_id], header reserved byte 0x00. Every codec id and variant id in the top-level `codecs` table came from one of these reports, each in its own dedicated capture window. THE WRITE SIDE IS UNTESTED on this firmware: `reserved` here is the byte the camera uses in its own reports, not a confirmed write value, and no write has been sent. Phase 3 step 12 (send_settings_command.py --packet codec_quality) is what promotes this. If the write is refused, the v7.9 profile's write-side value for this family is also reserved=0, so that is not the first thing to vary.

provenance.method: passive sniffer (sniffer_settings.py), one capture window per concrete resolution and per concrete fps so each payload is unambiguously attributable
capture_refs: tools/captures/POCKET_6K_G2_v8.6/POCKET_6K_G2_v8.6_20260730T150* (BRAW resolutions, quality variants and fps windows, local/gitignored)
tools/captures/POCKET_6K_G2_v8.6/POCKET_6K_G2_v8.6_20260730T155537.json (dedicated fps sweep, one window per fps, local/gitignored)
provenance.notes: REPORT SIDE ONLY so far. Camera-originated 0x01/0x09 reports confirmed on v8.6: operation 0x02 (CAMERA_REPORT), data-type byte 0x02 (INT16), payload five little-endian int16 [fps_int, sensor_fps_int, width, height, flags], header reserved byte 0x00. Every width/height in the top-level `resolutions` table came from one of these reports. THE WRITE SIDE IS UNTESTED on this firmware and this block deliberately records what v8.6's own wire showed rather than v7.9's write-side values (design principle 6): data_type is INT16 (0x02, the observed report byte) and reserved is 0x00. NOTE FOR PHASE 3 STEP 12: on v7.9 the working WRITE used data-type byte 0x82 (INT16_ARRAY) and reserved 0x01, even though that camera also *reported* with 0x02 — so if a write from this block is refused, retry with `send_settings_command.py --data-type INT16_ARRAY` before assuming anything about the values, and only then edit this block. FLAGS FIELD: element 5 is not purely fps-derived. It read 0x0000 at 6K (6144x3456) and UHD, and 0x0010 at every windowed/cropped resolution, all at the same fps_int=24 — independently reconfirming on v8.6 the 'windowed mode' bit already noted in the v7.9 profile's fps_modes._comment and in docs/photo_capture.md 10.1. 23.98fps added 0x0003 on top (0x0013 total) where exact rates stayed 0x0010, so the low bits carry the NTSC/drop indicator — reconfirmed by the full fps sweep (docs/settings.md 18.7): every NTSC/drop rate (23.98/29.97/59.94) shows 0x0013, every exact rate (24/25/30/50) shows 0x0010. fps_60 is the one exception — see fps_modes._fps_60_comment for why it has no entry.

provenance.method: explicit hypothesis block, added to unblock Phase 3 step 10 — NOT sniffed on this firmware and not confirmed by any write yet
provenance.notes: WHY THIS EXISTS AS A HYPOTHESIS: video_format never appears in a passive capture on any camera tried so far (POCKET_6K_G2 v7.9 docs/settings.md 7, POCKET_6K_PRO v8.6 15, and reconfirmed on this firmware by the 2026-07-30 sweep, 18.3) — there is nothing to seed it from. But send_settings_command.py must be able to BUILD a video_format packet before it can probe a dimension_enum, so step 10 is unreachable without a block. Same bootstrap the PRO needed (commit 'Unblock POCKET_6K_PRO video_format dimension_enum probing'). The coordinates are the officially documented FORMAT packet ones (category 1 / parameter 0, docs/protocol.md), and are made plausible for THIS firmware by codec_quality and recording_format both matching v7.9's coordinates exactly on v8.6's own captures. RESERVED IS THE WEAKEST FIELD HERE: 0x01 is what v7.9's and the PRO's working writes used for this family, but v8.6's recording family turned out to accept both 0x00 and 0x01 (commands.recording.provenance), and every v8.6 report seen so far carries 0x00. If a probe gets no response, vary this byte FIRST via send_settings_command.py --reserved 0x00 rather than editing this block. Nothing here is confirmed until an active send produces a real transition on the 0x01/0x09 mode-notify channel — video_format's own channel is not expected to echo at all.

codecs._comment: Sniffed on v8.6 2026-07-30, one capture window per concrete codec/variant; provenance rides with commands.codec_quality. Nothing inherited from POCKET_6K_G2_v7.9.json (design principle 6) — the values happen to match that profile, which is a confirmation, not a copy. BRAW variant id 6 was not observed on v8.6 either (a real gap between 12:1 at 5 and Q1 at 7) — do not invent it. The ProRes variant named 'Proxy' here was captured in a window the operator labelled 'pxy'; the id (3) is what was sniffed, the name follows this codebase's existing convention.

resolutions._comment: Widths/heights sniffed on v8.6 2026-07-30 from 0x01/0x09 reports, one capture window per concrete resolution; provenance rides with commands.recording_format. NO dimension_enums YET: video_format (0x01/0x00) never reported passively on this firmware either, exactly as on the G2 v7.9 — every enum must be probed actively (Phase 3 step 10, tools/control/send_settings_command.py --packet video_format --dimension-enum, or sweep_dimension_enum.py). Until then set_camera_format cannot reach any of these. HD IS MISSING ON PURPOSE: its capture window (res_prores_hd) was the first window of its run and caught the post-connect initial-payload burst instead of the resolution report, so no width/height was observed — re-capture rather than assume 1920x1080. The `codecs` list per entry records which codec family the operator reached that resolution under on the camera's own menus. Note 2.8K 17:9 is 2880 wide here, matching the sniffed POCKET_6K_PRO v8.6 profile. The v7.9 profile records 2868 for the same label; which is right for that firmware is unresolved and unfalsifiable now (it can no longer be re-tested) — see docs/settings.md 18.1. Do not reconcile the two profiles by editing either value.

fps_modes._comment: 7 of 8 modes, all CANDIDATE. fps_int and frame_flags read directly off v8.6's own 0x01/0x09 reports (2026-07-30, docs/settings.md 18/18.7), each in its own capture window, all at 2.8K 17:9 BRAW: 23.98 -> flags 0x0013, 24 -> 0x0010, 25 -> 0x0010, 29.97 (encodes as fps_int 30) -> 0x0013, 30 -> 0x0010 (independently reconfirmed byte-identical across two separate sweep sessions), 50 -> 0x0010, 59.94 (encodes as fps_int 60) -> 0x0013. m_rate IS THE ONE INFERRED FIELD in every entry: it is a video_format element and video_format never reports passively, so it cannot be observed at all until step 10's active probe. The inference is grounded in this firmware's own wire rather than another profile: the windowed-sensor bit is 0x0010, so an extra 0x0003 on top (0x0013 total) is the NTSC/drop indicator, giving m_rate=1 for 23.98/29.97/59.94 and 0 for the four exact rates. Confirmed or refuted by step 10/12. MISSING ON PURPOSE: 60 — see the 'fps_60' finding below, not a capture accident.
fps_modes._fps_60_comment: NOT a fps_modes entry — deliberately absent. 'fps_60' has now produced ZERO 0x01/0x09 reports across TWO separate sniffer_settings.py sessions (2026-07-30), both at 2.8K 17:9 BRAW, even though codec_quality (0x0A/0x00) reported fine in the same window both times — ruling out a dead/burst-contaminated window as the explanation both times. Candidate camera-side ceiling, same shape as POCKET_6K_PRO v8.6's 6K/50fps max_fps_int (docs/settings.md 17) — but NOT promoted to max_fps_int here, because that precedent was only accepted after the operator directly confirmed the ceiling on the camera's own UI, and that confirmation hasn't happened for this resolution/codec yet. Before recording a real ceiling: (1) check whether 60fps is even offered in the body's menu at 2.8K 17:9 BRAW, and (2) retry the capture at other resolutions (60fps might just be unreachable at THIS specific windowed crop, not camera-wide) — see docs/settings.md 18.7.
